## 

The Norm Chronicles: Stories and numbers about danger - Amazon
An entertaining guide to the statistics of personal risk, The Norm Chronicles will enlighten anyone who has ever worried about the dangers we encounter in our daily lives. Is it safer to fly or take the train? How dangerous is skydiving? And is eating that extra sausage going to kill you?

## 

The Norm Chronicles: Stories and numbers about danger - Amazon
In The Norm Chronicles, journalist Michael Blastland and risk expert David Spiegelhalter explore these questions through the stories of average Norm and an ingenious measurement called the MicroMorta - a one-in-a-million chance of dying.
